attempt_budget: 4 X1 configs + S1 control + CASH; no extras, no reruns for selection. Mechanical reruns preserve identical configuration and are disclosed.

configs.mechanism: NEW FAMILY: ETH catch-up after a BTC impulse it has not matched (BTC60>=35bps AND raw gap>=35bps same sign); 50% gap-closure target, static invalidation stop, 120s horizon
Strict leader-laggard: 50/50 thresholds filter marginal impulses; same exit construction and 120s horizon
Timed leader-laggard: 35/35 trigger with a 60s horizon for faster decay of the catch-up edge
Flow-confirmed leader-laggard: 35/35 trigger plus laggard 10-bar directional fraction>=0.58 filters adverse drift during entry latency
UNCHANGED CONTROL: price expansion continues after an executable entry (ROUND-01 baseline params, frozen)

controls: X1-R1-S1 is the unchanged ROUND-01 S1 baseline control
costs: Nautilus paper engine through the frozen research.backtest harness; ledger economics at REALISTIC (base config costs) and ADVERSE (2x: taker_bps x2 AND spread profile x2, frozen definition). Selection uses REALISTIC ledger net. Intent preset conservative-simulation 5/5/5/1 (comparability with S1 control).

data_designations.calibration: DEV day indices 1-5, beta estimation ONLY (tools/x1_beta.py, frozen procedure); no trigger/outcome contact
data_designations.development: DEV idx1-15 via --splits dev, cap 30min per config
data_designations.test: TEST idx23-30 BURNED for this round unless a candidate advances (then scored once, archived)
data_designations.validation: VAL idx16-22 via --splits validation, cap 2h per config; scored once for selection

horizon_note: X1/X1-S/X1-F use the frozen 120s holding limit; X1-T uses the frozen 60s horizon. No other horizon exists in v0.1.0.
hypothesis: A sharp BTC impulse that ETH has not matched (raw gap >=35bps same sign) predicts short-horizon ETH catch-up sufficient to cover executable costs at a 50% gap-closure target.
prior_use_disclosure: X1 family is NEW: no X1 outcome has been viewed on any data. S1 control arm was defined/selected in prior rounds on overlapping captures (disclosed selection effect on the control reference only).
qualification_screen: Preserved: >=100 closed out-of-sample positions spanning >=10 days + positive net under realistic/adverse costs + acceptable risk. Descriptive screen, not a selection override. If data cannot meet it, label DATA BLOCKED; never lower it.
rejection_rule: Reject the hypothesis unless an X1 config shows positive REALISTIC ledger net on BOTH dev and validation; then the single selected candidate advances to untouched evaluation. Negative end = rejected hypothesis + mechanical NONE.
selection_rule: Advance AT MOST ONE X1 config: highest validation REALISTIC ledger net among configs with dev_net > 0 AND validation_net > 0. Ties: higher dev net, then lexical config_id. Else NONE (RESEARCH UNRESOLVED). S1/CASH never advance. Applied by frozen tools/x1_select.py.
